shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (−3, 0) in the left image with the marker at 0.5 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted function excludes the left endpoint at x = −3. Right image: The interval excludes the lower boundary 0.5.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
